name: Desk Organizer
description: A pen cup and matching tray, as a set or on their own. Round, hexagon, square or stacked-rings shape; horizontal colour stripes or vertical colour blocks across 2-6 colours; radial dividers in the cup and compartments along the tray; a name inlaid flush in the front of each piece. The cup's height is capped at twice its footprint so it cannot tip. Up to 7 colours.
source: inspired by Printables "Catch-All Trays / Desk organizer" by HribaDesign (376225, 38,230 downloads), "Woven Pencil Holder" by JamesThePrinter (202588, 26,701 downloads) and "Wavy Pencil Holder - Vase mode" by SNASA (327316, 22,902 downloads)
